title: Grimer May Starve Because Water Got Cleaner
premise: Cleaner factory wastewater sounds like progress, but it removes the food Grimer needs to survive.
audiencePromise: Reveal why cleaner factory water creates a food crisis for Grimer, then ask which matters more.
openLoop: How can cleaner wastewater push a Pokémon toward extinction?
payoff: Grimer turns a polluted world into food, yet sterile environments can make it die.
engagementQuestion: Which matters more: clean wastewater or Grimer’s food supply?

voice.instructions: Speak like a knowledgeable fan sharing a disturbing twist. Start sharp, build urgency with short pauses, then slow slightly before the final either-or question.

scenes.headline: CLEAN WATER, HUNGRY GRIMER
scenes.narration: Cleaner factory water may push Grimer toward extinction.
scenes.caption: ON THE VERGE OF EXTINCTION

scenes.headline: SLUDGE IS ITS FOOD
scenes.narration: Grimer’s main food is slimy industrial waste from factories.
scenes.caption: FACTORY WASTE FUELS GRIMER

scenes.headline: GRIMER DRINKS FILTHY WATER
scenes.narration: It squeezes through sewer pipes to drink filthy wastewater.
scenes.caption: SEWER PIPES ARE FOOD ROUTES

scenes.headline: THE FOOD SOURCE VANISHED
scenes.narration: Then clean factory wastewater leaves Grimer with nothing to eat.
scenes.caption: FACTORY WASTEWATER IS CLEAN

scenes.headline: STERILE CONDITIONS CAN KILL
scenes.narration: Sterile environments stop its germs from multiplying, and Grimer dies.
scenes.caption: GERMS CAN’T MULTIPLY

scenes.headline: WHICH FUTURE WINS?
scenes.narration: Which matters more: clean wastewater or Grimer’s food supply?
scenes.caption: CLEAN WASTEWATER OR GRIMER FOOD?
